title: Static GK: Books and authors (Past Year Questions)

questions.q_en:
Who among the following has authored the play 'Nil Darpan'?

Options:
questions.solution_en:
1) Background of 'Nil Darpan':

o 'Nil Darpan' is a Bengali play written in 1860 by Dinabandhu Mitra.

o It portrays the plight of Indian farmers who were forced into cultivating indigo under oppressive conditions by British planters.

2) Historical Significance:

o The play became a crucial tool for awakening public opinion against British exploitation.

o It was later translated into English by Rev. James Long, leading to Long's imprisonment by the British government.

Incorrect options:

· Motilal Nehru: A prominent Indian leader, but not associated with literary works like 'Nil Darpan.'

· Chittaranjan Das: A lawyer and freedom fighter, known for his political contributions, not for writing this play.

· Sarojini Naidu: Renowned poet and political leader, but unrelated to this work.
questions.solution_hi:
1) 'नील दर्पण' की पृष्ठभूमि:

o 'नील दर्पण' 1860 में दीनबंधु मित्र द्वारा लिखित एक बंगाली नाटक है।

o यह ब्रिटिश बागान मालिकों द्वारा दमनकारी परिस्थितियों में नील की खेती हेतु मजबूर किए गए भारतीय किसानों की दुर्दशा दर्शाता है।

2) ऐतिहासिक महत्व: यह नाटक जन जागरण हेतु एक महत्वपूर्ण उपकरण बना।

questions.q_en: Who among the following is the author of the novel 'Q and A'?
questions.solution_en: Q & A was published in 2005 and is the first novel of Indian diplomat Vikas Swarup.
questions.solution_hi: 'Q & A' 2005 में प्रकाशित हुई व भारतीय राजनयिक विकास स्वरूप का पहला उपन्यास है।

questions.q_en: Who is the author of the book 'HazaarChaurasi ki Maa'?
questions.solution_en: Mahasweta devi is the author of the book 'HazaarChaurasi ki Maa'. Mahasweta Devi was an Indian writer in Bengali and an activist. Her notable literary works include Hajar Churashir Maa, Rudali, and Aranyer Adhikar.
questions.solution_hi: महाश्वेता देवी 'हज़ार चौरासी की माँ' पुस्तक की लेखिका हैं। महाश्वेता देवी बंगाली में एक भारतीय लेखिका व कार्यकर्ता थीं। उनकी उल्लेखनीय साहित्यिक कृतियों में हज़ार चौरासी की माँ, रुदाली व अरण्येर अधिकार शामिल हैं।

questions.q_en: Who among the following is the author of the epic poem 'Kamayani'?
questions.solution_en:
Jaishankar Prasad was a prominent figure in modern Hindi literature as well as Hindi theatre. Prasad was his pen name. He was also known as Chhayavadi poet. Kamayani and "Ansu" are his famous works.

Kamayani literally means 'the daughter of Kama'. In Indian literature Kama denotes something more than a mere libido-sense. As Vincent Smith has rightly pointed out, it bears a combined meaning of Libido and Eros of the Greek mythology
questions.solution_hi:
जयशंकर प्रसाद आधुनिक हिंदी साहित्य व हिंदी रंगमंच की एक प्रमुख हस्ती थे। प्रसाद उनका उपनाम था। उन्हें छायावादी कवि के रूप में भी जाना जाता था। कामायनी व "आँसू" उनकी प्रसिद्ध कृतियाँ हैं।

कामायनी का शाब्दिक अर्थ है 'काम की पुत्री'।

questions.q_en: Who among the following wrote the novel 'Rangbhumi' the arena of life?
questions.solution_en: Rangbhoomi: The Arena of Life is a Hindi language novel by Premchand. The novel features an idealist protagonist inspired by Gandhian values.
questions.solution_hi: रंगभूमि: द एरेना ऑफ लाइफ प्रेमचंद द्वारा हिंदी भाषा का उपन्यास है। इस उपन्यास में गांधीवादी मूल्यों से प्रेरित एक आदर्शवादी नायक है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following social reformers of 19th century India was the author of 'Stree Purush Tulana'?
questions.solution_en: Tarabai Shinde was a prominent social reformer in 19th century India, and she is the author of the groundbreaking work 'Stree Purush Tulana' (A Comparison Between Women and Men). This work was one of the earliest to criticize the oppression of women in Indian society, focusing on the inequalities between men and women.
questions.solution_hi: ताराबाई शिंदे 19वीं सदी के भारत में एक प्रमुख समाज सुधारक थीं, व वे अभूतपूर्व कृति 'स्त्री पुरुष तुलना' की लेखिका हैं। यह कृति भारतीय समाज में महिलाओं के उत्पीड़न की आलोचना करने वाली सबसे शुरुआती कृतियों में से एक थी।

questions.q_en: Who has written the book Sangeet Bal Prakash?
questions.solution_en: The correct answer is Vishnu Digambar Paluskar, a renowned Indian classical musician and musicologist known for his contributions to Hindustani classical music.
questions.solution_hi: सही उत्तर विष्णु दिगंबर पलुस्कर हैं, एक प्रसिद्ध भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीतकार व संगीतशास्त्री जो हिंदुस्तानी शास्त्रीय संगीत में अपने योगदान हेतु जाने जाते हैं।

questions.q_en: Which of the following is the autobiography of Bhishma Sahni?
questions.solution_en:
· Bhishma Sahni, the renowned Hindi writer and playwright, penned his autobiography titled "Aaj ke Ateet" (Today's Past).

· The book reflects on his life experiences, including his childhood, education, and involvement in social and literary movements.

Further insight:

· Aatma Parichaya → This is the autobiography of Premchand.

· Aarhdakatha → This is the autobiography of Firaq Gorakhpuri, a noted Urdu poet.

· Pankhhin → This is not an autobiography but a novel by Bhishma Sahni.
questions.solution_hi:
• प्रसिद्ध हिंदी लेखक व नाटककार भीष्म साहनी ने अपनी आत्मकथा "आज के अतीत" लिखी।

• यह पुस्तक उनके जीवन के अनुभवों को दर्शाती है, जिसमें उनका बचपन, शिक्षा व सामाजिक व साहित्यिक आंदोलनों में भागीदारी शामिल है।

questions.q_en: Who among the following freedom fighters of India is the author of the book, 'The Indian Struggle'?
questions.solution_en:
The author of the book 'The Indian Struggle' is Subhas Chandra Bose.

This book, published in 1935, is an autobiographical account of India's struggle for independence from British rule. It focuses on the period from the First War of Indian Independence in 1857 to the year 1942, and offers insights into Bose's views on the Indian freedom movement.
questions.solution_hi:
पुस्तक 'द इंडियन स्ट्रगल' के लेखक सुभाष चंद्र बोस हैं।

1935 में प्रकाशित यह पुस्तक ब्रिटिश शासन से भारत की स्वतंत्रता संग्राम का आत्मकथात्मक विवरण है। यह 1857 के प्रथम स्वतंत्रता संग्राम से लेकर 1942 तक की अवधि पर केंद्रित है।

questions.q_en: Which Indian singer wrote 'Raag Sarita'?
questions.solution_en: 'Raag Sarita' was written by Chintaman Raghunath Vyas, a noted Indian classical musician and musicologist. He made significant contributions to Indian classical music through his writings and compositions.
questions.solution_hi: 'राग सरिता' भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीतकार व संगीतशास्त्री चिंतामणि रघुनाथ व्यास द्वारा लिखी गई। उन्होंने अपने लेखन व रचनाओं के माध्यम से भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत में महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया।

questions.q_en: Which of the following is a book written by Avni Doshi?
questions.solution_en: The first sentence of a novel has a lot riding on it. In Avni Doshi's debut novel, "Burnt Sugar," that first sentence is: "I would be lying if I said my mother's misery has never given me pleasure." It is wonderfully striking, direct and confident, and devilishly funny. Such a voice, from a woman, rarely makes it onto the page. Women are often made to sound nice.
questions.solution_hi: किसी उपन्यास के पहले वाक्य पर बहुत कुछ निर्भर करता है। अवनि दोशी के पहले उपन्यास, "बर्न्ट शुगर" में, वह पहला वाक्य अद्भुत रूप से प्रभावी, प्रत्यक्ष व आत्मविश्वासी है। ऐसी आवाज़, किसी महिला से, कागज़ पर शायद ही आती है।

questions.q_en: Who among the following wrote the novel 'The Great Gatsby'?
questions.solution_en: The Great Gatsby, third novel by F. Scott Fitzgerald, published in 1925 by Charles Scribner's Sons. Set in Jazz Age New York, the novel tells the tragic story of Jay Gatsby, a self-made millionaire, and his pursuit of Daisy Buchanan, a wealthy young woman whom he loved in his youth. Unsuccessful upon publication, the book is now considered a classic of American fiction and has often been called the Great American Novel.
questions.solution_hi: द ग्रेट गैट्सबी, एफ. स्कॉट फिट्ज़गेराल्ड का तीसरा उपन्यास, जो 1925 में चार्ल्स स्क्रिबनर्स संस द्वारा प्रकाशित हुआ। जैज़ युग के न्यूयॉर्क में सेट, यह उपन्यास जे गैट्सबी, एक स्वनिर्मित करोड़पति, व डेज़ी बुकानन के प्रति उसके प्रेम की दुखद कहानी बताता है।

questions.q_en: Which author wrote the Hindi novel 'Tamas'?
questions.solution_en:
• Bhisham Sahani authored the Hindi novel 'Tamas', which is based on the partition of India and the resulting communal riots.

• Shrilal Shukla: Raag Darbari (1968), a satirical novel depicting rural Indian life and bureaucratic corruption; Seemayein Tootati Hain, a novel on social change; Vishrampur Ka Sant, a novel exploring spiritual hypocrisy.

• Yashpal: Jhootha Sach (1958 - 60), a two-volume novel on Partition and independence; Divya, a novel on ancient Indian society; Dada Comrade, a novel about revolutionary movements.

• Premchand: Godan (1936), a novel on rural poverty and exploitation; Gaban (1931), a novel on greed and redemption; Sevasadan (1918), a novel on women's social issues; Nirmala (1927), a novel on dowry and marriage.
questions.solution_hi:
• भीष्म साहनी ने हिंदी उपन्यास 'तमस' लिखा, जो भारत के विभाजन व उसके परिणामस्वरूप हुए सांप्रदायिक दंगों पर आधारित है।

• श्रीलाल शुक्ल: राग दरबारी (1968), ग्रामीण भारतीय जीवन व नौकरशाही भ्रष्टाचार को दर्शाने वाला व्यंग्यात्मक उपन्यास।

questions.q_en: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Coalition Years'?
questions.solution_en:
In his book 'The Coalition Years', former president Pranab Mukherjee, had disfavoured the Congress' 2003 decision to forge alliances to defeat the BJP in the 2004 general elections.

The Coalition Years begins its journey in 1996 and explores the highs and lows that characterized sixteen years of one of the most tumultuous periods in the nation's political history. It is an insightful account of the larger governance phenomenon in India - coalition politics - as seen through the eyes of one of the chief architects of the post-Congress era of Indian politics.

Author Pranab Mukherjee was the 13th President of India. A man of unparalleled experience in governance, he has the rare distinction of having served at different times as Foreign, Defence, Commerce and Finance Minister.
questions.solution_hi: अपनी पुस्तक 'द कोएलिशन ईयर्स' में, पूर्व राष्ट्रपति प्रणब मुखर्जी ने 2004 के आम चुनावों में भाजपा को हराने हेतु गठबंधन बनाने के कांग्रेस के 2003 के निर्णय की आलोचना की थी। यह पुस्तक 1996 से शुरू होती है व सोलह वर्षों के उतार-चढ़ाव का अन्वेषण करती है।
